title: UAAP: Late Fritz Chua goal lifts Adamson over Ateneo
summary: Fritz Chua struck late to lift Adamson University to a 2-1 triumph over Ateneo de Manila University in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament on Thursday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
